desc: Franklin Armory's patented Binary Firing System (BFS) is now available for the Glock 22 Gen3! The innovative G-S223 trigger allows you to seamlessly switch between semiautomatic and Binary modes, reducing split times and tightening groupings for improved accuracy. Like all BFS triggers, the release round can be cancelled by switching back to semiautomatic while the trigger is still depressed, offering full control. The integrated back plate mode indicator ensures you can easily confirm which mode you're in without taking your eyes off the target. Ideal for defense, sporting and recreational use, this system enhances both performance and versatility.
